snapshot.title: Customer Service: Hilltop Zone 2 Pressure Complaint

fields.subject: Resident reports no water and low pressure in Hilltop Zone 2
fields.description: Resident at 2200 Summit Drive, Hilltop Zone 2, reports no water and sustained low pressure. Calls every 10 minutes; first call received at 05:55. No visible break on street. Pressure at the hospital (PIT-600) confirmed at 18 psi — down from 24 psi at 05:00. Requester confirms this is a Tier 1 public complaint and the surge line is now active. Form CS-2 logged.

activity.author: Customer Service Lead – Renee Dupree
activity.text: Surge line activated per C1.4. Customer contact: (555) 037-1555. Location tagged: Hilltop Zone 2, near Westgate Street. First complaint from public cluster. Escalated to PIO for media log and rumor log initiation.
